Theme

Latin word

neuter

neuter, neutra, neutrum

pronoun and adjective; gen. neutrīus, dat. neutrī · Declension on Wiktionary

intransitive, neither active nor passive (of verbs); neither (of two); neuter; of verbs, neither active nor passive

In this lexicon

  • intransitive

    the recommended word · classical · Gell. 1.7.15 (Lewis & Short s.v. neuter); Traupman 227

  • neither

    the recommended word · classical · Quint. 1.1.14: neutra alterī officiat; Caes. BC 1.35.5: dēbēmus neutrum eōrum contrā alium juvāre (Lewis & Short); Traupman 68

  • neuter

    also used · classical · Cic. Or. 155; Gell. 1.7.15 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 221, 247

Examples

  • Dā exempla verbī neutrālis. — Sedeō, stō, cubō.

    Give some examples of an intransitive verb. — I sit, I stand, I lie.Traupman 228
